title: Vesper and the Prom
author: A. M. Vasquez
blurb: Paloma Ashgrove, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before the last game of the season.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
